body.purpose: All primary reading content — card descriptions, question text, dashboard summaries.

label.purpose: Button text, status badges, table headers, small UI labels. Always 12px.

title.purpose: Card headings, section titles — one step above body, used sparingly.

mono.purpose: Score fractions (12/15), progress percentages, data values requiring precise alignment.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Hover lift for interactive cards — barely perceptible, just enough to signal affordance.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover states, color transitions, opacity changes.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for UI interactions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Purple fill, white text. Used for primary actions: upload, confirm, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 16px; background-color: var(--color-brand-500); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.75); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-500); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subtle purple-tinted background. Used for secondary actions that need a purple association without full emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 16px; background-color: var(--color-brand-100); color: var(--color-brand-700); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--color-brand-200); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background-color: var(--color-brand-300); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-500); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Stroked, transparent fill. Used for browsing files, cancel, or when a ghost action needs a visible boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 16px; background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: var(--color-brand-50); } .ds-btn-outline:active { background-color: var(--color-brand-100); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-500); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No fill, no border. Used for toolbar icons, inline controls, or the lightest touch action.

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Red fill for destructive actions: delete project, remove file. Used sparingly and always with confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 16px; background-color: var(--color-error); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms, filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-error); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-running { background-color: rgba(140, 120, 240, 0.1); border-color: rgba(140, 120, 240, 0.2); color: rgb(140, 120, 240); } .ds-badge-completed { background-color: rgba(80, 200, 120, 0.1); border-color: rgba(80, 200, 120, 0.2); color: rgb(80, 200, 120); } .ds-badge-failed { background-color: rgba(200, 80, 80, 0.1); border-color: rgba(200, 80, 80, 0.2); color: rgb(200, 80, 80); } .ds-badge-pending { background-color: rgba(200, 180, 50, 0.1); border-color: rgba(200, 180, 50, 0.2); color: rgb(200, 180, 50); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge-dot-running { background-color: rgb(140, 120, 240); animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-badge-dot-completed { background-color: rgb(80, 200, 120); } .ds-badge-dot-failed { background-color: rgb(200, 80, 80); } .ds-badge-dot-pending { background-color: rgb(200, 180, 50); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.css: .ds-stage { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--color-surface); transition: all 200ms; } .ds-stage-active { border-color: var(--color-brand-500); background-color: var(--color-brand-50); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-stage-step { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-stage-circle { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-stage-circle-active { background-color: var(--color-brand-500); color: #fff; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-stage-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-stage-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-stage-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-brand-500); } .ds-stage-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-stage-bar { margin-top: 8px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: var(--color-brand-200); overflow: hidden; } .ds-stage-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: var(--color-brand-500); transition: width 500ms; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.overview: Inspired by IXL Learning's clean, educational aesthetic, this system combines the approachability of a well-organized classroom with the precision of a laboratory instrument. Light surfaces with purple anchors create an environment that feels both scholarly and inviting — like a math workbook that's been thoughtfully designed by someone who genuinely cares about the experience. The system explicitly rejects decorative excess (gradient text, glassmorphism, bounce animations) and enterprise heaviness (oversized headers, monotonous card grids, dense data-table-only layouts). Every component serves a pedagogical workflow: upload, preview, process, analyze. Nothing is ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: Clean, light-dominant surfaces with purple as the single accent voice
Flat-by-default elevation with subtle hover lift
Rounded but not cuddly — radii are measured (6px–12px), not pill-shaped
Dual-theme: light and dark are equal citizens, switched via `.dark` class
OKLCH color system for perceptual uniformity across themes

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Purple is the only accent color. Success/warning/error are semantic signals, not decorative accents. Do not introduce a second accent color — the system's restraint is its identity.

rules.name: The No-Headroom Rule
rules.body: This system does not define display or hero typography. The largest size is 15px/600 for titles. This enforces the tool-kit character: every component stays at UI scale, never competing with the consuming application's own hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to interaction state (hover, open, focus). If you can't see the shadow without looking for it, it's right.

dos: Do use purple as the single accent voice. It appears on primary buttons, active indicators, focus outlines, and progress fills — nowhere else.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest. Use shadows sparingly and only for interactive feedback or elevation hierarchy.
Do use semantic colors strictly for their meaning: Jade = success, Amber = warning, Vermilion = error. Never use them decoratively.
Do use OKLCH for all color definitions — it ensures perceptual consistency between light and dark themes.
Do make all interactive elements keyboard-accessible and screen-reader friendly (type="button", aria-label, role attributes).
Do use the mono font for scores and data values to ensure precise alignment in tables and progress displays.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences by keeping transitions brief (150–250ms) or suppressing animation entirely.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color. The system's restraint is its identity.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, bounce animations, or ornamental flourishes.
Don't use enterprise-heavy patterns: oversized headers, dense data-table-only layouts, identical card grids.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px as accent). Use full borders, background tints, or icons instead.
Don't use em dashes. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't use inline #000 or #fff. Tint all neutrals toward the brand hue with low chroma.
Don't define display/hero typography — this is a UI toolkit, not a marketing design system.
Don't nest cards. Cards are already the boundary element; nesting them is always wrong.
